purpose: Illustrative new task completion under visual triggering; oracle is an explicitly privileged reference.
selection: Post-evaluation illustration: first sorted rescue, prioritizing real unmodified-policy errors. Not used for model or case selection.
primary_detector_inputs: before/current pixels, proposed action, goal,target,own observation phase
render_fixture: CSS caret hidden, solid button borders, double-RAF native CDP capture; raw PNGs unedited; not stock benchmark rendering
raw_pngs: Unedited native captures; MiniWoB MIT notice in ../MINIWOB_LICENSE.txt
visual_limit: The button scene can remain visually unchanged after a successful click. Completion is verified by the recorded native reward/termination/task_info, not by inventing a visible acknowledgment.
